'''Xenovirus Prime''' was a genetically engineered virus designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Fizz Galko]] who served as a bioengineer for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. This was considered amongst his greatest experiment with the intention of introducing a pathogen that targeted alien species who were loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Those carriers of the virus posed no risk of infecting others.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the virus was used as part of an initiative against the Republic and was being used on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Doctor Galko was responsible for administering the virus to the planet's most dangerous prisoners who were the intended carriers and vectors for spreading it to the Republic. He would later task a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] spacer with detecting the infected aliens and marking their cells for Imperial reference.
